nativeBaseline.reference: native editable text input controlling a custom listbox popup

library: combobox/listbox roles and aria-expanded, aria-controls, and aria-activedescendant relationships
DOM focus remains on the editable input while Up/Down Arrow moves the active enabled visible option
popup options are excluded from the sequential Tab order and disabled options are skipped
Enter commits the active option and Escape dismisses the popup without moving DOM focus
active options are scrolled into view when aria-activedescendant changes
consumer: provide a meaningful accessible input name and validation descriptions
provide concise option names, stable values, application data, and any remote-search/loading behavior
own form serialization, required/validation policy, and server-side interpretation of the selected value

notes: Combobox uses the APG editable listbox-popup active-descendant model: DOM focus stays on the native text input while assistive-technology focus moves through listbox options.
Home, End, printable characters, and other native text-editing keys are not intercepted by Combobox navigation.
The active option uses aria-selected while navigating suggestions; committing with Enter updates the selected value and closes the popup.
Manual assistive-technology evidence remains owned by #633 and is not manufactured by this mapping.
